description: Search German public tenders like vergabeweiser.de/suche. Free text in German may contain a trade and a place ("Gebäudereinigung Rosenheim", "Dach 25 km um 90402"). Returns 20 results per page with deadline, buyer, place, estimated value and the page URL. result.framework_max is the ceiling of a framework agreement, never an award sum.

buyer_group.description: Only tenders of a buyer group: bund (federal bodies incl. Bundeswehr and Autobahn GmbH), bundeswehr, autobahn-gmbh, deutsche-bahn, fraunhofer, aok, deutsche-rentenversicherung, krankenhaeuser (hospitals), hochschulen (universities), polizei, stadtwerke; by title: schulen (schools), kitas; eu-weit: only tenders with an EU-wide notice

gewerk.description: Trade slug from list_categories, e.g. gebaeudereinigung

land.description: Bundesland slug from list_categories, e.g. bayern

place.description: Place: city, postcode or its first digits, Kreis or Bundesland (name or code), e.g. "Rosenheim", "90402", "904", "Bayern", "BY". Also as people write it: with a radius ("München 25 km", "50 km um München"), with words around it ("Raum Stuttgart", "Nürnberg und Umgebung"), postcode and city ("80331 München"), the Stadt or Landkreis of a name ("Fürth Stadt", "München Land"), part of a city ("Berlin-Mitte" = Berlin), a list ("Köln/Bonn" = Köln). "Deutschland" and "bundesweit" mean no place. A name several places share usually means the larger town ("Halle" = Halle (Saale)) or the Landkreis of that name ("Harburg"); another one with its Kreis, Land or qualifier: "Halle (Landkreis Holzminden)", "Halle (Westf.)", "Halle NRW", "Auerbach (Oberpfalz)". understood.place in the result says how it was read, understood.unknown_place that it was not

procedure.description: tw: with Teilnahmewettbewerb, einladung: by invitation only

query.description: Free text in German: trade, subject, buyer name, optionally a place, e.g. "Unterhaltsreinigung Schule München"

radius_km.description: Radius around place in km, default 50. Goes before a radius written into place

sort.description: frist: next deadline first, neu: newest, wert: highest value, treffer: relevance

status.description: offen: open (default), bald: deadline within 7 days, ergebnisse: awarded or ended, alle: all

with_value.description: Only tenders with an estimated value or award sum

name: search_tenders
title: Ausschreibungen suchen
